page.layout: One printed title page, one column of centred lines, with an engraved frame in the middle of the page and the printer's imprint below it. The lines are faint and mirrored by show-through from the reverse, so most of the text is marked illegible.

main_text.l: Dogmatum Veritatis, quae secundum pietatem sunt, [?]

page.notes: The page is a title page with an engraved frame; the engraving shows a partly legible banner with a scroll and is not transcribed. The title lines are faint and appear mirrored, probably show-through from the reverse side, so the readings above are uncertain and the [?] marks show where I could not confirm the letters. The first lines of the title are too faint to read at all. The imprint "Typis IOH. HENRICI BOGMERI" and the date "MDCC" are the clearest readings on the page.
